task: Add a Microsoft Exchange integration UI entry (settingsUIConfig.ts declarative config, conditional fields, Yup validation, tests) to the Integrations page.

key_reasoning.reason: One self-contained config entry (a full CredentialTypeConfig object with conditional fields and validation) added to CREDENTIAL_UI_MAPPING; SettingsForm and CredentialFields already consume it generically, so no other component or layer boundary is crossed.

Exact precedent exists for every mechanism needed — email's auth_type-select-plus-shouldShow shape, MS Teams's no-URL/no-test-button shape, sql's per-field Yup when()-conditional validation, and the existing sensitive:true convention for secret fields — but the analysis flags several silent-failure precision risks (literal serverEnum string, testable:false omission, missed sensitive flag) that keep this a notch above trivial.
